description: This script generates and tests certificate policy configurations, including ASN.1 structures, for certificate policies, with functions to create policy qualifiers, encode policies, and generate test files.

classes.name: CertificatePoliciesGenerator
classes.description: Class for generating certificate policies in ASN.1 format, adding policies, and outputting to files.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates ASN.1 encoded certificate policies and writes to output file.

methods.name: add_policy
methods.description: Adds a policy to the generator's list of policies.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns ASN.1 string representation of all added policies.
